title: ELIXIR-GOBLET Train-the-Trainer (TtT) Handbook
description: This handbook contains the core lessons of the ELIXIR-GOBLET Train-the-Trainer (TtT) course, along with supporting materials - a lesson plan, a guide for contributors, and a directory of trainers by session - plus links to complementary lessons on related topics.
